lines: 辛苦了！这里是宝可梦中心。在这里\n可以回复宝可梦的体力。要让您的宝{be01}\n可梦休息一下吗？
久等了！交给我的宝可梦们全都变得\n精力充沛了哦！

I wonder how many kinds of Pokémon
there are in the world?{be01}
It’d be great to cross seas and
trade Pokémon with people far away.
Those rotten scoundrels who steal\nPokémon and rip off Meteorites...{be01}\nI haven’t seen them around recently.
我听说过那些偷宝可梦抢陨石的恶徒\n的事情。
{0100:0} took a closer look at the\nHoenn region map.
